mrisbm

Source: R/data.R
mrisbm.Rd

NACCADRC UDS, SCAN Imaging MRI dataset. The data is sourced from the file(s) investigator_clariti_mrisbm_naccDEV.csv, mrisbm_duplicates.csv, investigator_scan_mrisbm_nacc73.csv, mrisbm_clariti_no_edc.csv.

Usage

data(mrisbm)

Format

A data frame with 6415 rows and 253 variables:

NACCID

Participant ID

NACCADC

ADC at which participant was seen (100 –9999)
